summary: Busy arterial kerb beside parkland; no parked cars and no room off the lane.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked on this kerb
No shoulder, kerb against grass bank

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto parkland and a car park, with apartments 19-35 m away across the road; seclusion is fine but the road is the problem.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb sits directly on the through lane with a narrow verge and trees; no pull-off or lay-by.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial with steady traffic in both images.
drivers.convention: Only moving cars; signs show No Stopping Any Time, No Stopping Mon-Fri 4-6:30pm and 2P 7am-4pm.

flags: Steep in places: 3.3% mean, 5.8% max grade
Mixed signs: 2P daytime, No Stopping peak hours
sun_shade: Mature trees shade the kerb from the north and midday sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park to the north is open overnight
